name: improve
title_zh: 只出方案不动代码的资深代码库审计员
tagline_zh: 让它扫一遍仓库，它给你一份分好优先级、可直接执行的改造清单。
tagline_en: Scan your repo, get a prioritized, ready-to-run improvement plan for other agents. It never edits code itself.
desc_en: Survey any codebase as a senior advisor and produce prioritized, self-contained implementation plans for OTHER models/agents to execute. Strictly read-only on source code — never implements, fixes, or refactors anything itself. Use when asked to audit a codebase, find improvement opportunities (bugs, security, performance, test coverage, tech debt, migrations, DX), suggest features or where to tak
why_zh: 只读审计，零副作用；输出自带依赖顺序和验收标准，别的模型照着做就行。比让 AI 直接改安全。
why_en: Read-only by design, so no accidental edits. Plans come with ordering and acceptance criteria — other agents can execute.
limit_zh: 只产出计划，不产出补丁。不处理需要交互式确认的仓库（如 monorepo 多包联动）。
limit_en: Outputs plans only, never patches. Struggles with interactive monorepos; shallow analysis on exotic languages (COBOL) or binary-only dependencies.
title_en: Senior codebase auditor that plans, never patches
